overviewDescription: Review learning activity, support tickets, and teacher request signals.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Invite or assign accounts, reset passwords, and move accounts through their lifecycle. Accounts are never deleted.
accounts.dateOfBirthHint: Optional. Decides whether the account is a minor.
accounts.reasonPrompt: Reason for this change (recorded in the audit log)
accounts.inviteNotDelivered: Account {{accountNumber}} was created, but the email was not delivered. Pass the link on yourself or resend it.
accounts.inviteFailed: The invitation could not be created.
accounts.assignFailed: The account could not be created.
accounts.reissueFailed: The invitation could not be reissued.
accounts.passwordReset: Password reset. The account must choose a new one at the next sign-in.
accounts.passwordResetFailed: The password could not be reset.
accounts.statusFailed: The status could not be changed.
accounts.loadFailed: The account list could not be loaded.
accounts.reasonRequired: Enter a reason first: every account change is recorded.

errors.account_peer_admin_password_reset_forbid: An administrator cannot reset another administrator's password. That account has to be reset from AWS.
errors.account_last_active_admin: This is the only administrator still active. Activate another one before changing this account.
errors.account_self_deactivation_forbidden: You cannot deactivate your own account.
errors.account_state_invalid: This account is not in a state that allows the change.
errors.invitation_not_reissuable: This invitation was already replaced or revoked. Send a new one.
errors.date_of_birth_invalid: That date of birth is not a valid past date. Use the day, month and year of birth.
errors.account_exists: This email address already has a {{role}} account. The same address may hold one account per role, but not two of the same role.
errors.action_not_allowed: You do not have permission to list accounts. Ask an administrator for the account-lookup capability.
errors.account_not_a_student: Only a student account has a weekly teacher-support figure.
errors.allowance_version_conflict: Another administrator changed this figure while you were editing it. Reopen it to see the current one.
errors.link_target_not_found: One of the two accounts cannot be used: it does not exist, does not hold that role, or is not active. Both accounts have to be active.
errors.link_already_exists: These two accounts are already linked. Nothing was changed.

accounts.emailHint: Must contain @. Case does not matter.
accounts.dateOfBirthStudentHint: Optional. Decides whether the student is a minor — leave empty rather than guess.
accounts.inviteExplainer: Sends a registration link; the person sets their own password.
accounts.assignExplainer: You fill everything in and get a one-time password to pass on.
accounts.assignDialogDescription: The account is created active. The initial password is shown once, and must be changed at first sign-in.

fieldIssues.role_required: Choose a role: student, teacher, parent or administrator.
fieldIssues.email_invalid: This is not an email address: it has to contain @.
fieldIssues.email_too_long: This email address is longer than 320 characters.
fieldIssues.name_too_long: The full name is longer than 120 characters.
fieldIssues.date_of_birth_invalid: The date of birth has to be a real past date in the form YYYY-MM-DD.

teacherSupport.assignedDefault: Currently {{count}} a week, the figure every student has.
teacherSupport.setByAdministrator: Currently {{count}} a week, set by an administrator.
teacherSupport.loadFailed: The current figure could not be read.
teacherSupport.saveFailed: The figure could not be saved.
teacherSupport.outOfRange: Enter a whole number between 0 and {{maximum}}.
teacherSupport.zeroWarning: Zero turns teacher support off for this student entirely — they will be told to contact an administrator, not that they have used this week up.

accounts.operationsDescription: One parent account across verification, child access and usage

parentLinks.title: Link a child to a parent
parentLinks.description: An administrator link takes effect at once and needs no confirmation from either side. It is the only way to link a minor: a parent's own request is refused whenever either account is under age, or has no date of birth on file.
parentLinks.filterLabel: Filter by name, email or number
parentLinks.relationshipHint: Stored with the link and written to the audit log.
parentLinks.submitExplainer: Links the two accounts immediately. Neither account is asked to confirm.
parentLinks.failed: The link could not be created.
parentLinks.loadFailed: The account list could not be loaded.
parentLinks.noParents: No active parent account matches this filter.
parentLinks.noStudents: No active student account matches this filter.

activation.title: Activate your account
activation.body: This invitation opens your STOA account. Choose a password, then sign in.
activation.dateOfBirthHint: Optional. Leave empty if your school has already recorded it.
activation.success: Your account is active. Sign in to get started.
activation.missingToken: This invitation link is missing a token. Open the link from your email.
activation.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
activation.failed: We could not activate this invitation. Please try again.

errors.invitation_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask an administrator to send a new one.
errors.auth_request_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
errors.account_exists: An account already exists for this email. Sign in instead.
errors.password_rejected: This password was rejected. Choose a stronger password.
errors.date_of_birth_invalid: That date of birth is not a valid past date. Use the day, month and year of birth.

scope.title: Operations scope
scope.covers: Administrators manage accounts under Users (invitations, assignments, password resets, suspension and archiving) and review teacher applications, the curriculum and moderation in their own sections.
scope.notYet: Support cases are not handled here yet, and system status is still to come.

accountOperations.description: Inspect verification, billing, child access, entitlement, and usage state for one parent account.

support.ready: No account operations blockers or warnings are currently reported.
